name: seo-audit-plugin
description: Evidence-driven SEO audit and diagnosis workflows with structured handoff for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Turn Codex into an evidence-driven SEO engineer.
interface.longDescription: Adds evidence-driven SEO workflows for technical audits, ranking-drop diagnosis, keyword opportunity research, and first-party organic-traffic analysis. It can inspect public pages and crawl resources, measure page performance and real-user experience, analyze third-party organic-search visibility and current search results, research keyword/competitor markets, use Google Search Console for first-party search performance/index facts, and use GA4 for Organic Search landing-page, engagement, key-event, geography/device, and post-click behavior evidence. The plugin stops at diagnosis/recommendation handoff; Codex or another Host remains responsible for repository edits, tests, builds, commits, publishing, and explicit content creation.
defaultPrompt: Audit this domain or URL for technical SEO problems and show evidence.
Diagnose why this domain, page, or query lost organic visibility.
Find realistic keyword opportunities for this site and separate high-value targets from easy-but-low-value keywords.
Analyze why Organic Search conversion changed and which landing pages or visitor segments matter most.
Audit this repository for technical SEO problems and prepare a Diagnosis Handoff.
